text: The maintainer's acts — resolving an UNKNOWN by a comment, merging a PR (the merge is the approval; GitHub's approve is not asked — PRs are opened under the maintainer's account, which cannot approve its own), activating a waiver, editing policy paths (`.github/workflows/**`, `.warrant/local/**`), pushing a freeze tag of `design-next`, restarting the Claude Code session, granting a scope to the agents' GitHub token — are never performed by the agent: it sends in the chat «❗ Выполнить — <what>:» and one command in a bash block, without `&&` (where the rule `process` says to ask in the PR — in the PR too); it checks the result itself (`gh pr view`, `git diff`). A merge, a waiver activation and a policy-path edit are each one command, `node <own worktree>/.claude/skills/slice/act.mjs merge <N>` · `waiver <change> <WAV>` · `patch <change> <file>` (a patch outside the repository; skill `slice`), asked after the agent's `--dry-run` passes; it acts and verifies, or refuses with the reason and changes nothing.
